from scipy.optimize import least_squares

__all__ = ['calibrate_stress_panel', 'align_coupon_panel', 'fit_thresholded_creep']


def calibrate_stress_panel(command: np.ndarray, measured: np.ndarray, stress_scale: float, *, archive_panels: tuple[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray], ...] = (), residual_fraction: float = 0.001, span_fraction: float = 0.1) -> tuple[float, float, bool]:
    """Return positive gain, physical bias, and whether an archive was consulted.

    Use one load cell at a time; command and measured stress share units.
    Archive panels are same-cell and oldest first. For small sweeps, enumerate
    affine lines and refit a strict-majority consensus without a ridge. Default
    residual and span gates are fractions of stress_scale. Transfer the latest
    compatible qualified archive block when current coverage is inadequate;
    update transferred bias only with nearby current checks.
    """
    if not all(np.isfinite(v) and v > 0 for v in (stress_scale, residual_fraction, span_fraction)):
        raise ValueError('calibration scale and fractions must be positive')

    def clean(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
        if a.ndim != 1 or a.shape != b.shape:
            raise ValueError('calibration checks must be matching vectors')
        keep = np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        return a[keep] / stress_scale, b[keep] / stress_scale

    def consensus(x, y, minimum, prior=None):
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        best = None
        for a, b in zip(i, j):
            dx = x[b] - x[a]
            if abs(dx) < np.sqrt(np.finfo(float).eps) * span_fraction:
                continue
            gain = (y[b] - y[a]) / dx
            if gain <= 0:
                continue
            bias = y[a] - gain * x[a]
            error = np.abs(y - (gain * x + bias))
            keep = error <= residual_fraction
            count = int(keep.sum())
            if count < max(minimum, x.size // 2 + 1):
                continue
            span = np.ptp(x[keep])
            if span < span_fraction:
                continue
            tie = -span if prior is None else abs(gain - prior[0]) + abs(bias - prior[1])
            key = (-count, tie, error[keep].sum(), gain, bias)
            if best is None or key < best[0]:
                best = key, keep
        if best is None:
            return None
        keep = best[1]
        coef = np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[x[keep], np.ones(keep.sum())], y[keep], rcond=None)[0]
        return (coef, keep) if coef[0] > 0 else None

    x, y = clean(command, measured)
    local = consensus(x, y, 4)
    if local is not None:
        return float(local[0][0]), float(local[0][1] * stress_scale), False
    newest = None
    support = []
    for a, b in reversed(archive_panels):
        ax, ay = clean(a, b)
        fit = consensus(ax, ay, 4)
        if fit is None:
            continue
        coef, keep = fit
        ax, ay = ax[keep], ay[keep]
        if newest is None:
            newest = coef
        elif np.max(np.abs(ay - (newest[0] * ax + newest[1]))) > 3 * residual_fraction:
            break
        support.append((ax, ay))
    if newest is None:
        raise ValueError('no qualified current or same-cell archive calibration')
    ax, ay = (np.concatenate(a) for a in zip(*support))
    pooled = consensus(ax, ay, 4, newest)
    prior = newest if pooled is None else pooled[0]
    local = consensus(x, y, 3, prior)
    if local is not None:
        gain, bias = local[0]
    else:
        gain, bias = prior
        offset = y - (gain * x + bias)
        near = np.abs(offset) <= 3 * residual_fraction
        if near.any():
            bias += np.median(offset[near])
    return float(gain), float(bias * stress_scale), True


def align_coupon_panel(features: np.ndarray, references: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return aligned features and a boolean missingness mask of the same shape.

    Row-aligned coupons and signals share a positive affine gauge within each
    group. Reference distributions must be comparable across groups. Use the
    median reference column mean and population spread, with at least two
    finite values per contributing column. With no shrinkage, impute from the
    equal-weight mean of supported group–stratum cell means, or zero for a
    wholly missing feature. Pass all unlabeled cohorts allowed for alignment.
    """
    x, ref = np.asarray(features, float), np.asarray(references, float)
    g, s = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if x.ndim != 2 or not len(x) or ref.ndim != 2 or len(ref) != len(x) or g.shape != (len(x),) or s.shape != g.shape:
        raise ValueError('features, references and labels must share a row axis')
    gi = np.unique(g, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    si = np.unique(s, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    observed = np.isfinite(x)
    aligned = np.full(x.shape, np.nan)
    for k in np.unique(gi):
        use = gi == k
        panel = ref[use]
        keep = np.isfinite(panel).sum(axis=0) >= 2
        if not keep.any():
            raise ValueError('a group has no supported reference column')
        panel = panel[:, keep]
        panel = np.where(np.isfinite(panel), panel, np.nan)
        loc = np.median(np.nanmean(panel, axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(panel, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not np.isfinite([loc, spread]).all() or spread <= 0:
            raise ValueError('a group needs finite reference location and positive spread')
        aligned[use] = (np.where(observed[use], x[use], np.nan) - loc) / spread
    cells = np.unique(np.c_[gi, si], axis=0, return_inverse=True)[1].ravel()
    total = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
    support = np.zeros(x.shape[1], dtype=int)
    for k in np.unique(cells):
        use = cells == k
        count = observed[use].sum(axis=0)
        total += np.divide(np.nansum(aligned[use], axis=0), count, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=count > 0)
        support += count > 0
    fill = np.divide(total, support, out=np.zeros_like(total), where=support > 0)
    return np.where(observed, aligned, fill), ~observed


def fit_thresholded_creep(past_stress: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray, durations: np.ndarray, times: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, feature_missing: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray, strain0: np.ndarray, strain_obs: np.ndarray, rate_obs: np.ndarray, fit_rows: np.ndarray, yield_stress: float, tau_bounds: tuple[float, float], *, late_time_ratio: float = 1.0, min_group_rows: int = 10, rank_rtol: float = 1e-6) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, dict]:
    """Fit a two-branch zero-initial-memory law with thresholded plasticity.

    History (N,H) is oldest first and piecewise constant over shared durations.
    Time arguments share units, rates are strain per time, stresses are already
    calibrated, and features are reference-aligned with missing values filled.
    Fit only fit_rows and omit their nonfinite observations. Normalize stress
    by yield and time by the geometric mean of tau_bounds. The late-time group
    screen uses this normalized time. Use bounded ordered relaxation times,
    Cauchy loss at two residual MAD scales, and no coefficient ridge. Exclude
    unsupported plastic columns before checking the robust Jacobian rank.

    Return ordered taus, shared hereditary weights (fast, slow, drift intercept,
    then feature slopes), plastic weights (hold, history), absolute strain,
    initial rate, and selected group drift offsets (intercept then slopes).
    Weights multiply the physical bases, not their normalized versions. On
    prediction-only rows with missing features, finite rates may update drift
    only, with missing-feature variance and complete-training rate noise as
    the shrinkage scales. This assumes independent feature errors within rows.
    """
    past, hold, dt, t, x, e0, obs, rate = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float),
        (past_stress, hold_stress, durations, times, features, strain0, strain_obs, rate_obs))
    missing, labels, train = np.asarray(feature_missing, bool), np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(fit_rows, bool)
    lo, hi = tau_bounds
    if not np.isfinite([lo, hi, yield_stress, late_time_ratio, rank_rtol]).all() or not (0 < lo < hi and yield_stress > 0 and late_time_ratio > 0 and 0 < rank_rtol < 1 and min_group_rows >= 2):
        raise ValueError('invalid relaxation bounds, yield or fit gates')
    if past.ndim != 2 or t.ndim != 1 or not t.size:
        raise ValueError('expected a history matrix and a nonempty time vector')
    n, h = past.shape
    if dt.shape != (h,) or x.ndim != 2 or len(x) != n or missing.shape != x.shape or obs.shape != (n, t.size) or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (hold, labels, e0, rate, train)):
        raise ValueError('inconsistent creep input dimensions')
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (past, hold, dt, t, x, e0)) or np.any(dt < 0) or np.any(t < 0):
        raise ValueError('physical inputs must be finite and times nonnegative')
    ts = np.exp((np.log(lo) + np.log(hi)) / 2)
    log_lo, log_hi = np.log([lo, hi]) - np.log(ts)
    dt, t = dt / ts, t / ts
    past, hold = past / yield_stress, hold / yield_stress
    remaining = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if h else dt
    ov = np.maximum(np.abs(hold) - 1, 0)**2 * np.sign(hold)
    work = (np.maximum(np.abs(past) - 1, 0)**2 @ dt) * hold
    X = np.c_[np.ones(n), x]
    base = 2 + X.shape[1]
    y = np.c_[obs - e0[:, None], rate * ts]
    valid = np.isfinite(y) & train[:, None]
    cy, ry = y[:, :-1][valid[:, :-1]], y[:, -1][valid[:, -1]]
    if not cy.size or not ry.size:
        raise ValueError('both strain and rate need finite training observations')
    es = max(np.median(np.abs(cy)), np.median(np.abs(ry)))
    if es == 0:
        es = np.max(np.abs(y[valid]))
    if es == 0:
        raise ValueError('zero response does not identify relaxation times')
    y /= es
    excited = valid[:, -1] | np.any(valid[:, :-1] & (t > 0), axis=1)
    cols = np.r_[np.arange(base), base + np.flatnonzero([np.any(ov[excited]), np.any(work[excited])])]

    def design(z):
        tau = np.exp(z)
        a, b = remaining[:, None] / tau, dt[:, None] / tau
        ea = np.exp(-a)
        kernel = ea * -np.expm1(-b)
        delta = hold[:, None] - past @ kernel
        dd = -past @ (a * kernel - ea * b * np.exp(-b))
        u = t[:, None] / tau
        step, dstep = -np.expm1(-u), -u * np.exp(-u)
        curve = np.concatenate((delta[:, None, :] * step, X[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None],
                                (ov[:, None] * t)[:, :, None], (work[:, None] * step[:, 0])[:, :, None]), axis=2)
        A = np.concatenate((curve, np.c_[delta / tau, X, ov, work / tau[0]][:, None, :]), axis=1)
        G = np.concatenate((dd[:, None, :] * step + delta[:, None, :] * dstep,
                            ((dd - delta) / tau)[:, None, :]), axis=1)
        H = work[:, None] * np.r_[dstep[:, 0], -1 / tau[0]]
        return A, G, H

    def mad(a):
        return max(1e-5, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(a - np.median(a))))

    def invert(mask, warm=None):
        curve_mask, rate_mask = mask[:, :-1], mask[:, -1]
        if mask.sum() < cols.size + 2 or not curve_mask.any() or not rate_mask.any():
            raise ValueError('insufficient strain and rate observations')
        ix = (mask.nonzero()[0][:, None], mask.nonzero()[1][:, None], cols)
        target = y[mask]
        scale = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.ones(t.size), 1.5], y.shape)[mask]
        bounds = (np.r_[log_lo, 0., np.full(cols.size, -np.inf)],
                  np.r_[log_hi, 1., np.full(cols.size, np.inf)])

        def logs(p):
            return np.array([p[0], p[0] + p[1] * (log_hi - p[0])])

        def unpack(p):
            c = np.zeros(base + 2)
            c[cols] = p[2:]
            return c

        def fun(p):
            return (design(logs(p))[0][ix] @ p[2:] - target) / scale

        def components(p):
            A, G, H = design(logs(p))
            c = unpack(p)
            G = G[mask] * c[:2]
            G[:, 0] += H[mask] * c[-1]
            return A[ix], G

        def jac(p):
            A, G = components(p)
            return np.c_[G[:, 0] + (1 - p[1]) * G[:, 1], (log_hi - p[0]) * G[:, 1], A] / scale[:, None]

        def optimize(p, cutoff):
            return least_squares(fun, p, jac=jac, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', f_scale=cutoff,
                                 x_scale='jac', max_nfev=180)

        starts = []
        grid = np.linspace(log_lo, log_hi, 8)
        for i, a in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
            for b in grid[i + 1:]:
                A = design(np.array([a, b]))[0][ix] / scale[:, None]
                z = target / scale
                w = np.ones(z.size)
                for _ in range(5):
                    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(A * w[:, None], z * w, rcond=None)[0]
                    r = A @ coef - z
                    w = 1 / np.hypot(1, r / max(2e-4, 2 * mad(r)))
                starts.append((np.log1p((r / 0.035)**2).sum(), np.r_[a, (b - a) / (log_hi - a), coef]))
        seeds = [p for _, p in sorted(starts, key=lambda pair: pair[0])[:4]]
        if warm is not None:
            seeds.append(warm)
        pilots = [optimize(p, 0.035) for p in seeds]
        pilot = min(pilots, key=lambda fit: fit.cost)
        error = design(logs(pilot.x))[0] @ unpack(pilot.x) - y
        nc, nr = mad(error[:, :-1][curve_mask]), mad(error[:, -1][rate_mask])
        scale = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.full(t.size, nc), nr], y.shape)[mask]
        fits = [f for f in (optimize(q.x, 2.) for q in pilots) if f.success]
        if not fits:
            raise RuntimeError('robust creep fit did not converge')
        p = min(fits, key=lambda fit: fit.cost).x
        A, G = components(p)
        J = np.c_[G, A] / scale[:, None] / np.hypot(1, fun(p) / 2)[:, None]
        norms = np.linalg.norm(J, axis=0)
        z = logs(p)
        if z[1] <= z[0] or np.any(norms <= np.finfo(float).eps * norms.max()):
            raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
        sv = np.linalg.svd(J / norms, compute_uv=False)
        if sv[-1] < rank_rtol * sv[0]:
            raise ValueError('creep parameters are not separately identifiable')
        return z, unpack(p), p

    logs, coef, warm = invert(valid)
    pred = design(logs)[0] @ coef
    complete = ~missing.any(axis=1)
    late = t >= late_time_ratio
    flagged = {}

    def late_slope(row, residual):
        v = late & np.isfinite(residual[row])
        return np.median(residual[row, v] / t[v])

    if late.any():
        residual = y[:, :-1] - pred[:, :-1]
        eligible = train & complete & np.any(valid[:, :-1] & late, axis=1)
        for label in np.unique(labels[eligible]):
            rows = np.flatnonzero(eligible & (labels == label))
            Z = X[rows]
            if rows.size < max(min_group_rows, X.shape[1] + 1) or np.linalg.matrix_rank(Z) < X.shape[1]:
                continue
            slope = np.array([late_slope(i, residual) for i in rows])
            fitted = Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, slope, rcond=None)[0]
            scatter = 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(slope - fitted))
            if np.std(fitted) > max(0.006, 3.5 * max(0.001, scatter)):
                flagged[label] = rows
    if flagged:
        main = train & ~np.isin(labels, list(flagged))
        try:
            logs, coef, _ = invert(valid & main[:, None], warm)
        except (ValueError, RuntimeError):
            # Preserve the common fit when excluding a group loses excitation.
            pass
        pred = design(logs)[0] @ coef

    offsets = {}
    local_slopes = np.broadcast_to(coef[3:base], x.shape).copy()
    residual = y[:, :-1] - pred[:, :-1]
    for label, rows in flagged.items():
        Z = X[rows]
        slope = np.array([late_slope(i, residual) for i in rows])
        q = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, slope, rcond=None)[0]
        keep = valid[rows, :-1]
        A = (Z[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None])[keep]
        target = residual[rows][keep]
        for _ in range(8):
            w = 1 / np.hypot(1, (target - A @ q) / 0.015)
            q = np.linalg.lstsq(A * w[:, None], target * w, rcond=None)[0]
        use = labels == label
        pred[use] += (X[use] @ q)[:, None] * np.r_[t, 1.]
        local_slopes[use] += q[1:]
        offsets[label] = q * es / ts

    update = ~train & ~complete & np.isfinite(rate)
    rate_controls = train & complete & np.isfinite(rate)
    if update.any() and rate_controls.any():
        noise = mad(y[rate_controls, -1] - pred[rate_controls, -1])
        variance = np.zeros(x.shape[1])
        for j in range(x.shape[1]):
            v = x[train & ~missing[:, j], j]
            if v.size:
                variance[j] = np.var(v)
        uncertainty = np.sum(missing[update] * variance * local_slopes[update]**2, axis=1)
        gain = uncertainty / (uncertainty + noise**2)
        shift = gain * (y[update, -1] - pred[update, -1])
        pred[update] += shift[:, None] * np.r_[t, 1.]

    hereditary = coef[:base] * es / np.r_[yield_stress, yield_stress, np.full(X.shape[1], ts)]
    plastic = coef[base:] * es / (ts * np.array([yield_stress**2, yield_stress**3]))
    return ts * np.exp(logs), hereditary, plastic, e0[:, None] + es * pred[:, :-1], es * pred[:, -1] / ts, offsets

    hold = rng.uniform(-4.8, 4.8, n)
    past[:20] = np.clip(past[:20], -2.5, 2.5)  # Hold-only excitation is possible.
    hold[20:40] = np.clip(hold[20:40], -2.5, 2.5)  # History-only excitation is possible.
    past[:2] = 0.5
    hold[:2] = [4., -4.]
    past[20], hold[20] = [-4., 0., 1., 0.], -2.
    dt = np.array([0.22, 0.41, 0.8, 0.34])
    t = np.r_[0., np.geomspace(0.07, 9., 20)]
    tau = np.array([0.5, 2.8])
    threshold = 3.
    hereditary = np.array([0.025, 0.040, 0.006, 0.011, -0.008])
    plastic = np.array([0.004, 0.002])
    x = rng.uniform(-1., 1., (n, 2))
    e0 = rng.normal(0., 0.002, n)
    labels = np.zeros(n, int)
    labels[74:95] = 2
    labels[-2] = 2
    offset = np.array([0.018, 0.075, -0.06])
    train = np.arange(n) < 95
    fm = np.zeros(x.shape, bool)
    fm[-2, 0] = True
    supplied = x.copy()
    supplied[-2, 0] += 1.0

    def truth(ps, hs, q, interaction):
        memory = np.zeros((n, 2))
        for j, d in enumerate(dt):
            decay = np.exp(-d / tau)
            memory = decay * memory + (1 - decay) * ps[:, j, None]
        amplitude = (hs[:, None] - memory) * hereditary[:2]
        work = (np.maximum(np.abs(ps) - threshold, 0)**2 @ dt) * hs
        amplitude[:, 0] += q[1] * work
        drift = np.c_[np.ones(n), x] @ hereditary[2:]
        drift += q[0] * np.maximum(np.abs(hs) - threshold, 0)**2 * np.sign(hs)
        if interaction:
            drift += (labels == 2) * (np.c_[np.ones(n), x] @ offset)
        return (e0[:, None] + amplitude @ (-np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau)).T + drift[:, None] * t,
                (amplitude / tau).sum(axis=1) + drift)

    curves, rates = truth(past, hold, plastic, True)
    obs = curves.copy()
    rate_obs = rates.copy()
    obs[0, 6] += 2.
    obs[4, 11] -= 1.5
    obs[train.size - 1] += 100.  # Prediction strain must not enter the fit.
    rate_obs[-1] += 50.  # Complete prediction row: do not use this rate.

    def mixed(ks, kt, perm):
        return fit_thresholded_creep(ks * past[perm], ks * hold[perm], kt * dt, kt * t, supplied[perm],
            fm[perm], (10 - labels)[perm], e0[perm], obs[perm], rate_obs[perm] / kt, train[perm],
            ks * threshold, (0.2 * kt, 8. * kt))

    fitted = mixed(1., 1., np.arange(n))
    tf, c, q, pred, rate_pred, offsets = fitted
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in fitted[:5])
    assert set(offsets) == {8}
    np.testing.assert_allclose(tf, tau, rtol=0.005)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(c, hereditary, rtol=0.015, atol=5e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(q, plastic, rtol=0.01, atol=1e-5)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(offsets[8], offset, atol=3e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred, curves, atol=8e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rate_pred, rates, atol=3e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred[:, 0], e0, atol=1e-14)
    # Stress and time are the physical axes; cohort grouping has no edge orientation.
    perm = rng.permutation(n)
    ks, kt = 0.01, 0.5
    scaled = mixed(ks, kt, perm)
    expected = (kt * tf, c / np.r_[ks, ks, kt, kt, kt], q / (kt * np.array([ks**2, ks**3])), pred[perm], rate_pred[perm] / kt)
    for actual, target in zip(scaled[:5], expected):
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual, target, rtol=2e-5, atol=2e-7)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(scaled[5][8], offsets[8] / kt, atol=2e-7)

    # Inclusive yield boundary and rejection of aliased drift columns.
    ps, hs = np.clip(past, -threshold, threshold), np.clip(hold, -threshold, threshold)
    pure_curve, pure_rate = truth(ps, hs, plastic, False)
    args = (ps, hs, dt, t)
    common = (labels, e0, pure_curve, pure_rate, train, threshold, (0.2, 8.))
    pure = fit_thresholded_creep(*args, x, np.zeros_like(fm), *common)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(pure[2], [0., 0.])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pure[0], tau, rtol=1e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pure[3], pure_curve, atol=1e-6)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pure[4], pure_rate, atol=1e-6)
    with np.testing.assert_raises_regex(ValueError, 'identifiable'):
        fit_thresholded_creep(*args, np.c_[x[:, 0], x[:, 0]], np.zeros_like(fm), *common)


run_self_test()
"
}
